title: Graduate Engineer (Graduate Program, civil and structural)
location: Brisbane QLD (Melbourne office at 400 Collins Street)
content_text: Bornhorst + Ward careers page (checked 11 Oct 2026 AEDT): 'Join our Graduate Program! For graduates, you'll be entrusted with responsibility on a variety of projects that shape the future of Queensland. You'll receive guidance from an experienced mentor who will help develop your skills and expertise across diverse and impactful projects. Many of our graduate positions are filled by former undergraduates, but we're always open to applications from passionate engineers eager to start their career with us. Applications are accepted annually, so if you're ready to start your engineering career with Bornhorst + Ward, we encourage you to submit your cover letter and resume to the below link.' Apply page: 'As a Graduate Engineer, you'll contribute to real jobs from day one, gaining practical industry experience while working alongside experienced professionals... With dedicated mentorship, flexible working arrangements and exposure to a diverse range of projects.' Offices: L14, 133 Mary Street, Brisbane QLD; L4, 400 Collins Street, Melbourne VIC. Civil and structural engineering consultancy since 1965.
apply_instructions: Submit a cover letter and resume through the Graduate Program form at https://www.bornhorstward.com.au/apply (applications accepted all year).
